test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The ratio of the number of boys and girls in school B is 6 : 7, and 40% of the students in school D are boys. The total number of girls in school B and D is:
solution:
Number of students in school B = (117/360) × 5400

⇒1755

Number of boys in school B = (6/13) × 1755

⇒ 810

Number of girls in school B = (7/13) × 1755

⇒ 945
